issue.title: Migrating legacy wallet aborts due to "new_db" assertion
issue.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

While there isn't an existing issue, there is a closed PR referencing the same problem: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36821

### Current behaviour

When trying to migrate a legacy wallet, bitcoin-core hits an assertion fault:
```
bitcoin-qt: ./wallet/wallet.cpp:3929: bool wallet::CWallet::MigrateToSQLite(bilingual_str&): Assertion `new_db' failed.
fish: Job 1, 'bin/bitcoin-qt' terminated by signal SIGABRT (Abort)
```

### Expected behaviour

It shouldn't hit an assertion fault.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open bitcoin-qt.
2. Select the relevant wallet to migrate in the menu.
3. Press ok on the question regarding opening the wallet after migration.
4. bitcoin-qt aborts.

events.body:
https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36821 suggests that using a network share might be the problem; Moving the wallet to my local drive indeed works around the problem. 
Since I need to apparently have the entire blockchain synced, not being able to do that on my NAS may be problematic in terms of disk space, but I guess that is a separate issue.
Please see the comments in the referenced PR https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36821. This is fixed by #34193.
